content.content: "Shine (Beatmasters 7" Mix)" by Aswad, released in 1994, is a masterful blend of reggae and dancehall. The song's unyielding tempo and dubby basslines, expertly remixed by The Beatmasters, create a dynamic and uplifting track. Beautiful close-knit harmonies and organic instrumentation elevate this paean to self-improvement, showcasing Aswad's return to their traditional roots-reggae strengths. A true gem of neggae.
content.title: Shine (Beatmasters 7" Mix)

alternatives.text: Aswad's 'Shine (Beatmasters 7" Mix)' showcases a fusion of reggae and electronic elements, creating a vibrant and uplifting sonic tapestry. Released in 1994, this track from the album 'Shine' exemplifies the band's ability to infuse traditional Caribbean rhythms with contemporary production techniques. The Beatmasters' remix breathes new life into the song, offering a fresh perspective on Aswad's iconic sound.
